notes.title: Mini Settings Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Changed unlocked framerate to 120fps for stability and speedrunning consistency reasons.
[*] Timer now displays milliseconds.
[*] Timer stays on top all the time now.
[/list]

notes.title: Speedrunner Quality of Life Update.
notes.content:
[h1]Show us how fast you can go![/h1]
We've been loving the recent speedrunning activity among the community and if you haven't already given it a go, we would love to see how fast you can beat the game! 

Upload your results to https://www.speedrun.com/lake_haven (thanks for MildGothDaddy for setting up the site).

[list]
[*] In game timer added to in-game settings.
[*] Settings will now be saved so you won't need to change settings on starting new game.
[*] Final cutscene can now be skipped.
[*] Fixed inventory maintaining when starting new game.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.21
notes.content:
- Can now use analogue stick to move for people who don't like dpad.
- Changed a few dialogue lines.
- Improved trigger for certain part of the game.
- Updated poppy painting light.
- Fixed immersion breaking cube. 
- Fixed radio bug where text stayed on screen.

notes.title: 1.2 Patch notes
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience with the crashes relating to light probes, I am confident that these crashes shouldn't be an issue anymore, please report any issues and we will do our best to help.

[*] Keys will now be removed after use.
[*] Made certain puzzle more obvious.
[*] Radio interaction now consistent between framerates.
[*] State of certain door maintains now.
[*] Added mild goof.
[*] Fixed wierd grammer mistake.
[*] Light Probe related hard crash fixed.

[list]
[*]Fixed soft lock in when using certain item twice.
[/list]

notes.title: Tiny Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Disabled unnecessary lighting settings to improve stability.
[/list]
